scope: 27 Towers games from one account, dated 8 and 13 November 2024 by the operator's own records, as served by the operator's share-bet endpoint, archived by the Wayback Machine and retrieved on 2026-10-28. Selected winning games shared by the account holder; not a sample of play.

account.note: published with the account holder's consent

precision_test.note: truncated_kdp = the exact compounded multiplier truncated to k decimals before multiplying; client_js_label_3dp = the label the captured client computes in JavaScript. Truncation at 7 or 8 decimals reproduces the same values as the full multiplier at these stakes, so the exact internal precision is not uniquely established; the 3-decimal ladder is ruled out.
